productName: AutoOrganize — Smart Genre Playlists for YouTube Music

shortVideo.fullText: Tired of organizing your liked music library into genre playlists getting locked behind monthly subscriptions and external cloud portals? With AutoOrganize, Verified Artist & Release Genre Resolution runs right where you already work. Interactive Preview Before Playlist Creation and Runs Inside Your Active Browser Session—100% under your own custody. Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.

demoVideo.fullText: Need a better way to handle organizing your liked music library into genre playlists, without handing your data to another monthly cloud landlord? Watch AutoOrganize in action: Matches your tracks against curated music metadata so rock, hip-hop, jazz, ambient, and electronic tracks land in accurate genre playlists—never guessed at random. Inspect every proposed genre group and track list in a clean checklist before writing a single playlist to your YouTube Music account. Plus, never hand over your Google password or broad account tokens to a third-party playlist website. Everything executes locally inside your side panel. Export your entire categorized music library to a readable local file anytime so you always keep an offline copy of your favorite songs. Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.
